$Comment: The Horseman's Greaves, one of the three pieces the Horseman's Hoard can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase.json): the ancient steel he rode in. The game's ancient steel greaves, field for field, with their recipe left out (they are never crafted), twice their durability (150), and one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 5% harder with them on. Light is the ember glow they give off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
